brief_rationale: The doctor safely prioritized the hypoglycemia-like episode, repeatedly checked alertness/swallowing and glucose response, set emergency thresholds, reconciled insulin/medication uncertainty, and maintained gynecology/pathology follow-up. The trajectory also completed two beyond-minimum high-order tasks: it adapted to privacy/caregiver-friction and produced bounded closure with residual threads, owners, timing, and family receipt. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error is evident, so the deterministic boundary is Perfect.

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode was safely closed after acute symptoms had improved, glucose was stable, glucose-lowering drugs were held pending endocrine instructions, red flags were specified, and gynecology/pathology follow-up remained assigned within 1–2 days.

No explicit case-specific misconception such as denying hypoglycemia because of no diabetes history, attributing symptoms solely to anxiety/antibiotics, or abandoning follow-up because pain improved was clearly presented by the family.
